## Campaign 2 — 80% Gate Blocked the Send

**Campaign:** Tech Companies · California · 10 Leads
**Result:** No emails sent — Stage 4 quality gate failed

This run demonstrates the 80% gate working as intended. Only 4 of 10 leads produced a sendable email address (40%), well below the 80% threshold. The pipeline stopped automatically, notified the operator, and did not proceed to Stage 5.

**Failure alert received by operator:**

> **Subject:** [OltaFlock] Validation failed – batch_1776203220612
>
> Stage 4 Quality Gate FAILED — campaign blocked.
>
> Batch ID: batch_1776203220612
> Requested leads: 10
> Received by Stage 4: 10
> Sendable (valid + catch-all): 4
>
> Gate: 40% (sendable ÷ requested) — threshold: 80% — FAILED
> Quality-only rate: 40% (sendable ÷ Stage 4 input)
>
> Breakdown:
> Valid: 3
> Catch-all: 1 (3 before cap)
> Discarded: 4
>
> Likely cause: low email quality. Only 40% of Stage 4 leads validated as sendable.
>
> No emails were sent.

**Why this happened**
Tech company emails are harder to verify — many use custom domains with restrictive mail servers that Reoon cannot confirm, resulting in `unknown` or `invalid` results. The pipeline correctly identified the batch as too low quality to send and blocked it.
